title.zh-cn: Nikon DX 与 FX 画幅说明

purpose.en: Compare 36 × 24 mm full frame with Nikon DX and see a 1.5× field-of-view example.
purpose.zh-cn: 比较 36 × 24 mm 全画幅与尼康 DX，并查看 1.5× 视角示例。

editorialNote.en: Nikon dimensions are one manufacturer's examples, not a definition of every APS-C camera.
editorialNote.zh-cn: 尼康尺寸是该厂商示例，不是所有 APS-C 相机的定义。

verification.evidence: The Nikon page describes 36 × 24 mm FX, approximately 24 × 16 mm DX, and a 1.5× view comparison.
